title: unitUidAdoption
responsibility: Joins source files to registered units by the uid they announce, so a moved or renamed file keeps its unit.

inputs.name: adoptUids.registry
inputs.description: The registry being reconciled, with the owner of each path from the stored units.

inputs.name: adoptUids.index
inputs.description: The indexed source files, some announcing a uid.

inputs.name: mergedByUid.all
inputs.description: The path-derived groups of source files.

inputs.name: unitUid.previous
inputs.description: The stored unit, if there is one.

inputs.name: unitUid.group
inputs.description: The group of files the unit is derived from, if any.

outputs.name: adoptUids
outputs.description: The same registry, with each uid-announcing file owned by the unit of that uid and the vanished files of moved units reported as moves.

outputs.name: mergedByUid
outputs.description: The groups in id order, with the groups that announce one uid joined into the first.

outputs.name: unitUid
outputs.description: The registered uid, else the uid of the group, else the one uid all files agree on; undefined when none.
